## Checklist

- [ ] Original wording: the note is written in our own words, not pasted from the sources
- [ ] Citations: front matter `sources` lists the public URLs behind the claims
- [ ] No PII: no personal email, QQ, phone number, personal blog, secret, or candidate data
- [ ] `status` stays `draft` until a person has reviewed the note, then changes to `published`
- [ ] Learning-path folders are unchanged (`Agent/`, `LLM/`, `MachineLearning/`, `Deploy and Optimis/`)
